skills.name: install-shorebird

skills.name: code-push-release

skills.name: code-push-patch
skills.description: Deploy over-the-air patches to Flutter applications without waiting for app store reviews.

skills.name: code-push-rollback
skills.description: Roll back a broken patch, or roll a rolled-back patch forward again, from the console or the Shorebird CLI.

skills.name: code-push-tracks
